{{Attr|Burn}} |ability1 = '''Spooking Flash''' - Upon death, the '''Cursed Horror''' explodes, creating a shockwave underneath that stuns towers for 2 seconds and deals 100 damage to units. }} ==Description== The '''Cursed Horror''' was a large, [[Flying]] enemy that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and a quite fast speed. Upon death, it would explode as an electric orb, creating a shockwave, stunning any tower for two seconds and damaging any unit caught from it by 100. It also had the [[Stun Immunity]], [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Burn Immunity]]. ==Appearance== The '''Cursed Horror''' was a giant, flying beast with an exposed skull. It had a tail and what appeared to be hair. Its skull was grey and has yellow lights in its eyeholes. ==Strategy== *Due to its high health and fast speed, towers with flying detection and high DPS are recommended. **The [[Ranger]] is likely the best option, as it is immune to its stuns and has quite large range, allowing it to cover the entire map. Other towers like the [[Engineer]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] can also be effective. *While it cannot collide with units due to it being a [[Flying]] enemy, it can still wreak havoc with its ''Spooking Flash'', allowing it to deal damage to units on death, killing weaker units or weakening them. **This is especially bad for units which stay on the path, leading to them stacking up, like units from the [[Crook Boss]] or some from the [[Mercenary Base]], as a '''Cursed Horror''' that flies above such groups of units can easily damage or even kill them all. *Because of its immunities, it cannot be frozen, knocked back, burned or chilled, while also only being slowed down by stuns. **As it is a [[Flying]] enemy, there are not many towers that can detect it, meaning a lot of them with some exceptions, like the [[Hallow Punk]] or [[Electroshocker]], would not be able to target it even if it was not immune. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CursedHorrorFloat.gif|Floating animation (31 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) }} ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Cursed Horror''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping do not decrease '''Cursed Horror's''' defense. **{{Bug}} '''Cursed Horror''' floats higher when its size gets changed. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Cursed Horror's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Cursed Horror''' removed. {{Containment|[[Rotting Terror]]|Wave 12|Cursed Horror|Wave 13|[[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]]|Wave 16 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]] & [[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]|hardw3 = Wave 17 (Hard)}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
